name: Yoyogi-Uehara
tagline: Shinjuku in 7 minutes and Shibuya in 13 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥110,000 to ¥120,000.
summary: The station is in Shibuya City, where Odakyu and Tokyo Metro run 2 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 21 minutes to Otemachi, 7 minutes to Shinjuku, 13 minutes to Shibuya and 36 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥110,000 to ¥120,000. The station stands 29.2 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 17.4 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 29.2 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 24.7 m to 42.1 m, a difference of 17.4 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 4 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is less than 0.5 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the small side for the 23 wards.

groceries.name: マルエツ 代々木上原店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 7 clinics and 10 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is BOWOW, about 12 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 荘敬会井上病院, about 12 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. Odakyu Odawara Line run through it. Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line also call here. The lines are split between operators (Odakyu runs 1 line and Tokyo Metro runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: Odakyu Odawara Line runs at 150% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 世田谷代田→下北沢, which this station is not on. Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line runs at 150%. Its busiest stretch is 町屋→西日暮里, which this station is likewise not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥110,000 to ¥120,000 and 1K ¥110,000 to ¥120,000. 1LDK ¥210,000 to ¥220,000 and 2LDK ¥310,000 to ¥320,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
drivers: Age and construction of the building
Whether it faces a main road or the railway
Whether it sits at the top or the bottom of a slope

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥110,000 to ¥120,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is on the low side. In plain yen, though, it is on the high side for the 23 wards. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Higashi-Kitazawa is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection and quiet, but Yoyogi-Uehara is ahead on the number of lines.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Yoyogi-Uehara. Higashi-Kitazawa has only the Odakyu Odawara Line, so Yoyogi-Uehara is the better connected. To Toranomon, for instance, Higashi-Kitazawa takes 7 minutes longer. On quiet, though, Higashi-Kitazawa comes out ahead.

Close enough to walk to from Yoyogi-Uehara. It is served by the same lines as Yoyogi-Uehara. Journey times to the main business districts are much the same. A one-room flat costs about ¥26,000 more at Yoyogi-Hachiman. On what it offers families, Yoyogi-Uehara comes out ahead.

goodFor: People who want a park close by
notFor: The data does not show a drawback particular to this station
noiseSources: 井ノ頭通り (2 lanes each way) runs just outside the station. In a flat facing it, the cars are audible morning and evening

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 6 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 4 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the low side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Morning loading on the lines here is about average for the 23 wards' stations.
leads.noiseSources: Whether a flat faces the road changes what you hear indoors.
